paragraphs.text: Fblthp , pronounced as " Fibblethip ", is a cowardly homunculus from Ravnica with a talent for getting hopelessly lost.

Fblthp serves the Azorius Senate , working in the Magister's Gardens. He was mostly left alone to do his duties, an arrangement he was quite happy with. He would tidy up and take care of the plants, content with his lot in life. One day, Arrester Parisha took him on a mission to capture the Rakdos criminal Vadax Gor, whose taste in victims had become more specialized and deviant. As part of the operation to apprehend the cultist, Fblthp was used as a lure. When Vadax quite literally took the bait, Parisha sprang into action and saved the put-upon homunculus.
For his participation and the mission's success, Fblthp was awarded the possibility of his descendants petitioning the Senate to create a tablet to register Fblthp's exploits upon his death.

Fblthp was present during the War of the Spark . He somehow found his way to the top of Nicol Bolas 's statue of himself, which was still preferable to the time he was stuck in the Juri Revue for a week.

When the New Phyrexian Invasion broke through on Ravnica, the first thing Fblthp did was run away — and he somehow promptly wound up on the frontlines of the invasion, facing down hordes of compleated Golgari . Luckily, he was rescued by Borborygmos , who happened to be smashing Phyrexians nearby. Inspired by the cyclops' combativeness, Fblthp decided to stay and assist. He squeaked in fright whenever a threat came too close, and Borborygmos repaid the favor by promptly turning and smashing whatever it was this tiny pipsqueak voice was yelling about in his ear. Together they were able to cover all possible angles of attack, making them an unstoppable duo in Ravnica's defense.

The opening of the Omenpaths after the Invasion was the worst thing that ever happened to Fblthp, greatly expanding the horizons he could find himself lost in. At various times over the next several years, he got lost on Thunder Junction , Innistrad , and Arcavios .

In the Echoverse , Fblthp was a creation of an Izzet shockmage specifically designed for navigation. He loved his work, finding lost archives, unknown glades, and alleyways that theoretically shouldn't have existed. The opening of the Omenpaths was the best thing that ever happened to Fblthp, and after an unfortunate accident ended his tenure as a servant, he was able to fully indulge his passion and travel endlessly across the planes.
